ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Powercfg Execution To Change Lock Screen Timeout
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious execution of 'Powercfg.exe' to change lock screen timeout

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powercfg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "PowerCfg\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/setacvalueindex\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*SCHEME\\_CURRENT.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*SUB\\_VIDEO.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*VIDEOCONLOCK.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-change\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-standby\\-timeout\\-.*"))))
